params.message: {{platform === 'win32' ? 'powershell -Command "$ollamaPath = (Get-Command ollama -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $ollamaPath) { $ollamaPath = \"$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\Ollama\\ollama.exe\" }; if (Test-Path $ollamaPath) { Write-Host OLLAMA_ALREADY_INSTALLED } else { Write-Host Descargando instalador de Ollama...; $installer = \"$env:TEMP\\OllamaSetup.exe\"; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://ollama.com/download/OllamaSetup.exe -OutFile $installer; Write-Host Instalando Ollama silenciosamente...; Start-Process -FilePath $installer -ArgumentList /S -Wait; Write-Host OLLAMA_INSTALLED }"' : 'which ollama && echo OLLAMA_ALREADY_INSTALLED || (curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh && echo OLLAMA_INSTALLED)'}}

{{platform === 'win32' ? 'powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$ollamaPath = (Get-Command ollama -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $ollamaPath) { $ollamaPath = \"$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\Ollama\\ollama.exe\" }; if (Test-Path $ollamaPath) { Start-Process -FilePath $ollamaPath -ArgumentList serve -WindowStyle Hidden | Out-Null; Write-Host OLLAMA_STARTED } else { Write-Host OLLAMA_NOT_FOUND }"' : 'ollama serve > /dev/null 2>&1 &'}}

params.html: ⬇️ Descargando modelo de IA (puede tardar varios minutos)...

params.message: {{ram < 6 ? 'ollama pull llama3.2:1b' : ram < 12 ? 'ollama pull llama3.2:3b' : 'ollama pull llama3.1:8b'}}

params.html: 📦 Instalando dependencias Python en el entorno virtual...

params.message: {{platform === 'win32' ? 'venv\\Scripts\\pip.exe install --upgrade pip --quiet && venv\\Scripts\\pip.exe install -r requirements.txt --quiet && echo DEPS_OK' : 'venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip --quiet && venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt --quiet && echo DEPS_OK'}}

{{platform === 'win32' ? 'powershell -Command "@(\"data/agents\",\"data/prompts/system\",\"data/sessions\",\"data/exports\",\"data/brands\",\"data/campaigns\",\"data/audit\") | ForEach-Object { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $_ | Out-Null }; Write-Host DIRS_OK"' : 'mkdir -p data/agents data/prompts/system data/sessions data/exports data/brands data/campaigns data/audit'}}

{{platform === 'win32' ? 'powershell -Command "if (-not (Test-Path data/agents/agents.json)) { Copy-Item defaults/agents.json data/agents/agents.json }; Get-ChildItem defaults/prompts/*.md | ForEach-Object { $dest = \"data/prompts/system/$($_.Name)\"; if (-not (Test-Path $dest)) { Copy-Item $_.FullName $dest } }; Write-Host DEFAULTS_OK"' : 'cp defaults/agents.json data/agents/agents.json 2>/dev/null || true; cp defaults/prompts/*.md data/prompts/system/ 2>/dev/null || true'}}

params.text: {{JSON.stringify({version: '0.1.0', installedAt: new Date().toISOString(), platform: platform, defaultModel: ram < 6 ? 'llama3.2:1b' : ram < 12 ? 'llama3.2:3b' : 'llama3.1:8b'}, null, 2)}}
